entries.name: stdVBA
entries.description: A framework containing numerous classes for automation and utility. Focuses on code compactness and long-term maintainability.

entries.name: VbCorLib
entries.description: A framework which brings many powerful .NET classes to VBA/VB6.

entries.name: Hidennotare
entries.description: A framework by Japanese author RelaxTools. Contains numerous classes, interfaces and forms.

entries.name: Advanced Scripting Framework (ASF)
entries.description: Complete scripting platform with JavaScript-like syntax, native Office ecosystem integration, classes with inheritance, professional debugging, zero dependencies, and VS Code extension.

entries.name: vb2clr
entries.description: Use C# from VBA using the .NET CLR runtime.

entries.name: VBA Expressions
entries.description: A powerful string expression evaluator focussed on mathematics and data processing.

entries.name: VBA-FastJSON
entries.description: Fast, cross-platform, native json parser and serializer. Memory efficient (non-recursive), RFC 8259 compliant, UTF8 support

entries.name: mdJSON
entries.description: JSON library with dot-notation for extracting paths.

entries.name: JSONBag
entries.description: Uses shebang notation to extract keys from JSON strings. Can also build JSON with this library.

entries.name: VBA-CSV-interface
entries.description: Powerful, fast and comprehensive RFC-4180 compliant CSV/TSV/DSV data management library.

entries.name: VBA-XML
entries.description: XML conversion and parsing.

entries.name: ZipArchive
entries.description: A single-class pure VB6 library for zip with ASM speed. Compatible with 32-bit VBA and Twinbasic.

entries.name: Excel-ZipTools
entries.description: Parse, read, and extract data from, Zip files. Written in pure vba.

entries.name: vbaSquash
entries.description: Compress and decompress files and byte arrays using the built-in cabinet.dll functions available on Windows 8+. Provides access to compression algorithms MSZIP, XPRESS, XPRESS_HUFF, and LZMS.

entries.name: vbaPDF
entries.description: VBA code for simple modification of PDF files (read in, combine, write out).

entries.name: Better array
entries.description: An array class providing features found in more modern languages.

entries.name: VBA-FastDictionary
entries.description: Fast, cross-platform, native Dictionary. Replacement for scripting dictionary.

entries.name: VBA-Dictionary
entries.description: A dictionary object which stores key-value pairs.

entries.name: VBA-ExtendedDictionary
entries.description: A dictionary object using Scripting.Dictionary but exposes some additional useful functionality.

entries.name: cHashList
entries.description: Simple, Fast and lightweight HashList class with no use of Win32 API. Requires string keys however.

entries.name: CollectionEx
entries.description: Extends the default VBA(/VB6) collection with methods to retrieve and check for key existence.

entries.name: clsTrickHashTable
entries.description: A hash table using machine code injected at runtime. Full replacement for scripting dictionary, with bonus features.

entries.name: VBA-Math-Objects
entries.description: A matrix and vector library.

entries.name: VBA Float
entries.description: An utility to perform computations over big integers and rational numbers with thousands digits.

entries.name: DuckDB VBA
entries.description: Embedded DuckDB OLAP engine for Excel/VBA using the native DuckDB C API through a lightweight DLL bridge. No ODBC setup or external server required; supports fast DuckDB SQL analytics, dictionary lookups, Range/Array ingestion, Parquet/CSV/JSON workflows, DuckDB/SQLite/PostgreSQL connectivity, and Access-to-DuckDB migration.

entries.name: SQL Library
entries.description: An OOP SQL Library for psql, mssql, mysql databases.

entries.name: Task Dialog
entries.description: A huge amount of UI functionality from this 1 class, in a strictly dynamic and modular way. Great for data input forms. Also see vbforums post for more information.

entries.name: ucSimplePlayer
entries.description: Simple video player user control.

entries.name: ucWebView2
entries.description: WebView2 user control.

entries.name: ucAniGifEx
entries.description: Animated GIF user control.

entries.name: Material UI
entries.description: Make your userform feel modern with Material UI.

entries.name: Easy EventListener
entries.description: Consolidate all event handling of a userform into 1 callback.

entries.name: Pseudo Control Arrays
entries.description: Optimal means of Consolidating all event handling of a userform. Demonstrates usage of ConnectToConnectionPoint API. Also worth looking at this class too.

entries.name: Modern UI Components
entries.description: Custom modern looking controls.

entries.name: MVVM
entries.description: Model-View-ViewModel Infrastructure for maintainable userform development.

entries.name: VBA Userform Transitions and Animations
entries.description: An excellent library for implementing animation easings into the Userform.

entries.name: Trick's Timer
entries.description: If you need to run a piece of code continuously and don't have access to Application.OnTime (and/or you need to run it faster than once per second), this is the class for you! Also check out the forum post for more information. Limitation: Requires a modal form.

entries.name: VBA-SafeTimer
entries.description: Reliable, no-crash timer for VBA. Code can be debugged and stopped safely. Works with or without a form.

entries.name: Drag and Drop filepaths
entries.description: Allow your userform to handle drag-and-drop files.

entries.name: Late-bound WebBrowser Control Events
entries.description: A technique to latch onto WebBrowser events in a late-bound manner.

entries.name: Mark's userform tools
entries.description: Numerous UI tools and pretty userforms.

entries.name: VBA-UserForm-MouseScroll
entries.description: Allows Mouse Wheel Scrolling on MSForms Controls and Userforms.

entries.name: MSForms (Pure VBA) Treeview Control
entries.description: A treeview control replacement by JKP and Peter Thornton coded entirely in VBA.

entries.name: MSForms (Pure VBA) ListBox Control
entries.description: Featured in this video. It has tons of useful features like sorting, filtering, single or multi-selection with select and deselect all, page navigation and hover highlight,

entries.name: Use of GDIPlus in VBA
entries.description: GDIPlus can be used to create a canvas like element where any image can be drawn to. Additionally check out this GDI32 class from the same author.

entries.name: Use of OpenGL in VBA
entries.description: OpenGL is a cross-language, cross-platform application programming interface for rendering 2D and 3D vector graphics. In this article the authors of the GDIPlus class.

entries.name: VB6 Graph Control
entries.description: Won't work natively in VBA without a PictureBox compatible substitute, but an extremely performant graph control regardless.

entries.name: WebView2 for Excel VBA
entries.description: A lightweight wrapper that exposes Microsoft Edge WebView2 on a UserForm, enabling HTML/JS UI, rendering, and two‑way communication with VBA. Effectively replaces the WebBrowser control.

entries.name: VBA-MemoryTools
entries.description: Provides an ultra-fast, copy memory alternative.

entries.name: Safe Subclassing
entries.description: Provides the ability to subclass Excel/Word/PowerPoint window or Userforms to perform further automation. In the later threads there is also an example for subclassing other windows from other applications.

entries.name: Calling private module functions
entries.description: You can also check out Greedo's code review.

entries.name: Universal DLL Calls
entries.description: A library which can be used to call functions of any function pointer, DLL or object in both STDCALL and CDECL.

entries.name: vbInvoke
entries.description: Application.Run but COM based and can call private module methods.

entries.name: VBA state-loss callback
entries.description: A crash free detector for VBA state-loss. State loss can occur when: Someone clicks end in an unhandled error; You click the VBA stop button; You enter design mode; Application exits.

entries.name: VBAStack
entries.description: A library for retrieving VBA callstack information at runtime from Office applications. The author also made a pure VBA native version.

entries.name: SHA256
entries.description: A repository of cryptographic primitives implemented in VBx and compatible with VB6, both 32- and 64-bit VBA and TwinBasic.

entries.name: vba-regex
entries.description: A native regex expression parser and runtime engine.

entries.name: VbPeg
entries.description: A parser generator for VBA. Converts PEG grammar like this into VBA code like this. Very useful if your implementing a new programming language in VBA. Wqweto has also included some math expression parsers as tests.

entries.name: Volpi's Math Expression Parser
entries.description: A fast math expression parser. Doesn't allow calls to objects, no callstack.

entries.name: ClooWrapperVBA
entries.description: Execute OpenCL from VBA, using either the GPU or CPU.

entries.name: VBA-Web
entries.description: Connect VBA, Excel, Access, and Office for Windows and Mac to web services and the web.

entries.name: Wasabi
entries.description: Native WebSocket, WSS, MQTT, and raw TCP client for VBA. Pure VBA, single-file, and zero dependencies.

entries.name: VBA-WebSocket
entries.description: Microsoft example code for a WebSocket client which can be used in conjunction with an echo server. There is also a class and an async version built by the discoverer of the microsoft code.

entries.name: vbAsyncSocket
entries.description: Simple and thin WinSock API wrappers for VB6 loosely based on the original CAsyncSocket wrapper in MFC.

entries.name: Edge Automation
entries.description: Automate Chromium Edge using devtools protocol. GitHub backup here.

entries.name: Chrome Automation (via devtools protocol)
entries.description: Automate Chrome using chrome devtools protocol.

entries.name: SeleniumVBA
entries.description: Drive selenium webdriver directly from VBA. If you don't have the driver installed, the library will attempt to download it for you and run it. However AV may restrict the running of this process.

entries.name: webxcel
entries.description: A webserver which runs a RESTful backend. The creator also made an article on how it works on dev.to.

entries.name: Rubberduck
entries.description: An open-source COM add-in project that integrates with the Visual Basic Editor to add modern-day features to the familiar IDE. Works in VBA6, VBA7.x (x86/x64), and yes, in VB6 too!

entries.name: VBA-IDE-Code-Export
entries.description: Addin contains a code importer and exporter for use with git (or any VCS).

entries.name: RibbonX
entries.description: AndyPope's Visual Ribbon Editor.

entries.name: Custom UI XML Editor
entries.description: Addin for directly adding, editing and validating ribbon XML (Excel 2010+).

entries.name: Ribbon Creator
entries.description: An excellent and intuitive WYSIWYG interface for the development of ribbons. The free shareware version allows for the export of up to two tabs per ribbon.

entries.name: MZ-Tools
entries.description: VBE addin providing development tools.

entries.name: VBA Resource File Editor
entries.description: Store other files inside your excel/word/powerpoint files for later use with this handy tool.

entries.name: vbRichClient
entries.description: An external client full of useful libraries.

entries.name: vbWatchDog
entries.description: vbWatchdog hacks the VBA runtime to provide module name, procedure name and line number where error occurred.

entries.name: DLL Function Viewer
entries.description: Allows the export of function names from DLLs.

entries.name: Accessibility Inspector
entries.description: An inspector/explorer for accessibility in applications. Useful for automation.

entries.name: Running Object Table Inspector
entries.description: An inspector for the running object table (ROT), a table of global running COM objects which can be obtained.

entries.name: Clipboard Inspector
entries.description: Allows inspection of data held in the clipboard. Useful for reverse engineering clipboard usage in other applications.

entries.name: Registry Inspector
entries.description: Allows inspection of the win32 registry. Equivalent of regedit basically, but implemented entirely in VBA.

entries.name: JSON Inspector
entries.description: An inspector for JSON data, can be called on demand too as a dev tool for inspecting API responses.

entries.name: vbaXray
entries.description: A pure-VBA class that reads, inspects, and exports VBA source code directly from Office binary files

entries.name: VBSpeed
entries.description: The Visual Basic Performance Site - focus on VB6 but transferrable across to VBA.
section: Algorithms, code optimisation, and performance testing

entries.name: Access Ribbon
entries.description: An excellent resource for information for developing custom ribbon XML. Although principally targeted at Access, it is equally applicable to Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

entries.name: Ron de Bruin - Ribbons/QAT
entries.description: A leading resource for information/samples on developing custom ribbons and context menus. (Hosted on Jan Karel Pieterse's site)

entries.name: Office MSO Icons
entries.description: Ribbon icons can often use one of the 1500 (3 pages on this site) MSO icons wich pre-exist in Office applications.

entries.name: Drag and drop control
entries.description: Dragging and dropping image controls around a userform.

entries.name: EZPZMouseController
entries.description: An example of using native Microsoft Ink Collector to detect mouse wheel and mouse move events.

entries.name: Iterating the ROT
entries.description: An example of iterating the Running Object Table (ROT) to find Excel Workbook instances.

entries.name: Excel Screen Reader
entries.description: Not only an example of UI Automation, but also an example of using SAPI to do text to speech.

entries.name: MenuRighter
entries.description: MenuRighter is an Excel addin that lets you modify right-click menus. You can add almost any control found in other right-click menus or Excel 2003's "classic" menus.

entries.name: Sam Rad's DatePicker
entries.description: Visually impressive and professional DatePicker addin for Excel. Worksheet only / cannot be used with userforms.

entries.name: Excel Name Manager
entries.description: An enhanced Name Manager replacement by JKP, Charles Williams and Matthew Henson. 2025 Finalist in the Best Microsoft Excel Add-In category.

entries.name: Excel Flex Find
entries.description: An enhanced Find-And-Replace replacement by JKP that exends the search scope to objects and VBA code.

entries.name: Word VBA Syntax Highlighter
entries.description: Custom built Syntax Highlight tool for Word Documents.

entries.name: MS Access VCS Addin
entries.description: Synchronize Access Forms, Macros, Modules, Queries, Reports, and more with a version control system for MS Access.

entries.name: xlStudio
entries.description: A DAW for Microsoft Excel. Also check out the awesome video.

entries.name: Cellivization
entries.description: A cool RTS-like game created in Excel. Also check out the awesome video.

entries.name: Arkanoid
entries.description: Arkanoid, a retro arcade game, built in Excel. On some machines it runs faster than others.

entries.name: ExcelCommodroid
entries.description: Commodore computer loader using MS Excel on Windows. VBA7 only.

entries.name: oletools
entries.description: Python tool which can be used to decode VBA P-Code (VBA's intermediate language).

entries.name: twinBasic
entries.description: A VBA compatible parser, evaluator and compiler.

entries.name: vscode-vba
entries.description: Extension that adds VBA editor support to Visual Studio Code.

entries.name: VBA Pro
entries.description: VSCode Extension that adds enhanced VBA support based on Language Service Protocol. The source is also on GitHub.

entries.name: VBA Build
entries.description: Github action to automatically build a VBA project on commit.

entries.name: VBA Project Compiler
entries.description: A python library which can be utilised to compile VBA projects. There is also a built-in Excel addin generator made by the same author! You can see a list of related projects by the author here.

entries.name: WinVBA
entries.description: A modern IDE for Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) development.

entries.name: VBE_Colours
entries.description: A small external utility to configure the colours of the VBE editor. Not open-source, but its Github presence provides additional information.

entries.name: RubberDuck's style guide
entries.description: Has some great intermediate - advanced guidance.

entries.name: VB6 Coding conventions
entries.description: Variable/Class/Module naming conventions used in VBA. Greatly helps organisation in VBE (unless you have rubberduck).

entries.name: Thunder - The birth of Visual Basic
entries.description: A little article about the birth of VB7/VBA.

entries.name: My First Bill Gates Review
entries.description: Joel Spolsky, program manager for the Excel team, recounts his first Bill Gates review. Joel got numerous features added e.g. IDispatch, Variant, For each and With. It also discusses the dreaded Date bug ported to Excel from Lotus 123.

entries.name: Ruby, EB and DLL composition
entries.description: Translated copy of VBStreets article created by Russian VBer Хакер. Details the composition of the VB6 and VBA dlls in amongst the history of the language.

entries.name: PCode Internals
entries.description: VBA is compiled to PCode. Understanding the lower level P-Code is a topic of heavy interest and research.

entries.name: How many lines of code in EB
entries.description: Untranlated article by Russian VBer Хакер which estimates the number of lines of code in VB6/VBA.

entries.name: SAFEARRAYS
entries.description: The internal structure of arrays.

entries.name: Articles by Sancarn
entries.description: Various articles written by Sancarn about VBA including, performance, actual issues with VBA etc.

entries.name: Microsoft Office Code Compatibility Inspector
entries.description: The Microsoft Office Code Compatibility Inspector was designed by Microsoft to troubleshoot compatibility issues with VBA code as when upgrading Office from 32-bit to 64-bit. MS has not maintained a link to the software for download from its servers, though versions of it are apparently available on the internet.

entries.name: Planet Source Code
entries.description: A code repository GitHub which holds copious amounts of code. The site was closed down in 2023, but fortunately all VBA/VB6 samples were archived on GitHub today. Possibly not the entire collection (?) of projects/source code that was previously available at the PSC website.

entries.name: vbAccelerator Archive
entries.description: Archived copy of vbAccelerator site (articles, source code, etc.) that disappeared in 2015, reappeared in 2018, and anyone's guess what's going to next… Primarily VB6, but useful VBA resource.

entries.name: Excel Development Platform Blog
entries.description: Blog dealing with advanced topics/VBA.

entries.name: Ron de Bruin
entries.description: Simple-Intermediate topics. Note: Ron has archived all these sites, it will not be updated, and some information is out of date, yet it is still an incredible resource for VBA.

entries.name: Bytecomb VBA Reference
entries.description: Intermediate-advanced topics.

entries.name: Chip Pearson's website
entries.description: Great resource for beginners-intermediate.

entries.name: VBA for smarties
entries.description: A great reference to numerous data structures and mechanics.

entries.name: Rubberduck Blog
entries.description: Intermediate-Advanced topics.

entries.name: Slipstick
entries.description: Website of Diane Poremsky (MVP) with focus on Outlook and VBA.

entries.name: TechnicLee
entries.description: Outlook blog, many examples including code variations depending on user request.

entries.name: PowerPoint VBA
entries.description: A site devoted to teaching VBA through making games in PowerPoint.

entries.name: MS KB Archive
entries.description: Massive archive of vb6/vba problems, solutions and tutorials.

entries.name: No Longer Set
entries.description: Access + VBA site of Microsoft MVP Mike Wolfe. Provides weekly updates on development of TwinBasic.

entries.name: Isladogs on Access
entries.description: Access + VBA site of Microsoft MVP Colin Riddington. Excellent resource with VBA projects in Access VBA.

entries.name: DevHut
entries.description: Access + VBA site of Daniel Pineault. Publishes series of deep-dive articles into various uses of VBA. Companion site to Youtube account.

entries.name: AnalystCave
entries.description: A site dedicated to VBA for analytics.

entries.name: The VBA Help
entries.description: A site dedicated to VBA with a large number of instructive blog posts. Written by the author of VBE_Extras, an AddIn for the VBA IDE and VBE_Colours, a small utility to configure the available colors used by the VBA IDE.

entries.name: Hard Core Visual Basic
entries.description: An advanced programmer's guide to the new 5.0 version of Visual Basic. Includes a core set of utilities, shortcuts, and solutions to problems to achieve a wide range of functional programs. A hard book also exists. Also check out the Comments and corrections.

entries.name: The VBA Developer's Handbook
entries.description: Write bulletproof VBA code for any situation. This book is the essential resource for developers working with any of the more than 300 products that employ the "Visual Basic for Applications" programming language. Hardbacks also available elsewhere.

entries.name: Advanced Visual Basic 6
entries.description: Power Techniques for Everyday Programs Matthew Curland. Hardbacks also available elsewhere.

entries.name: Professional Excel Development
entries.description: In this book, four world-class Microsoft® Excel developers offer start-to-finish guidance for building powerful, robust, and secure applications with Excel. Hardbacks also available.

entries.key: https://google.com/search?q=Excel VBA Programming For Dummies book
entries.name: Excel VBA Programming For Dummies
entries.description: It′s time to move to the next level—creating your own, customized Excel 2010 solutions using Visual Basic for Applications (VBA).Using step–by–step instruction and the accessible, friendly For Dummies style, this practical book shows you how to use VBA, write macros, customize your Excel apps to look and work the way you want, avoid errors, and more.

entries.name: Power Programming with VBA
entries.description: Excel 2019 Power Programming with VBA is fully updated to cover all the latest tools and tricks of Excel 2019. Encompassing an analysis of Excel application development and a complete introduction to Visual Basic for Applications (VBA), this comprehensive book presents all of the techniques you need to develop both large and small Excel applications.

entries.name: Excel Macro Mastery
entries.description: Paul Kelly (MVP) - excelmacromastery.com.

entries.name: Sigma Coding
entries.description: Large catalogue of tutorials - beginner through to advanced. Delves into interesting areas of VBA not explored by other content creators.

entries.name: WiseOwl's VBA tutorials
entries.description: Great all-round resource for VBA. Perfect introduction for beginners. In-depth lessons into all aspects of VBA. Huge playlist that covers most types of VBA.

entries.name: VBA A2Z
entries.description: Many tutorials, some paid content. Good array of interesting and different topics - in-depth tutorials into different parts of VBA, with some .NET/VSTO videos. Strong focus on UI development.

entries.name: Excel for Freelancers
entries.description: Hands-on tutorials to developing specific applications from beginning through to end. All levels.

entries.name: Leila Gharani
entries.description: Office-wide focus - useful for beginners.

entries.name: Get to know VBA
entries.description: Some great applications presented and created with VBA.

entries.name: D Pineault - Tech, Programming and more
entries.description: Youtube channel of Daniel Pineault. Companion channel to DevHut site.

entries.name: Reddit
entries.description: Daily VBA Q&A. Occasional Pro-Tip sharing and Show & Tell library publishing.

entries.name: Stack Overflow
entries.description: A great place to ask questions. Duplicate questions are flagged as duplicates and send the author to the correct place.

entries.name: Chandoo
entries.description: Forum for the Chandoo - the blog of Purna Duggirala (MVP). Very active.

entries.name: Visual Basic Discord
entries.description: A chat room for VB.NET/VBA/VB6 fanatics.

entries.name: Excel Discord
entries.description: Discord server moderated by Tim Heng (Excel MVP) with focus on helping Excel users.

entries.name: MrExcel
entries.description: Mostly Excel generic, but a lot of VBA content can be found here also.

entries.name: Slipstick
entries.description: Excellent forum for the Slipstick website (Outlook VBA) of Diane Poremsky (MVP). Diane is quick to respond, and her answers are extremely helpful.

entries.name: VBForums - Office Development
entries.description: Forum with focus on VB6/.NET with VBA section.

entries.name: Access World
entries.description: Forum with focus on Access and Access VBA.
